title: A Man For All Seasons - Giving the Devil the Benefit of Law
summary: A one-minute clip from the 1966 film A Man for All Seasons. Thomas More refuses to arrest the Devil, saying he would give even the Devil the benefit of law for his own safety's sake.
why: HN uses the scene to argue for due process and for protecting the speech and rights of people you dislike.
topic: due process and rule of law

quote.text: There's a brief excerpt of the film on Youtube that resonates particularly well today
